theorem branch_split {b q : ℕ} (σ ν : ℕ → ℕ) (hσ : ∀ t ≤ q, σ t ≤ 1) (hν : ∀ t ≤ q, ν t ≤ 1)
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (V W : ℕ) :
    (V = Nat.land (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), σ t * (2 ^ b) ^ t) (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), ν t * (2 ^ b) ^ t) ∧
        ∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), σ t * (2 ^ b) ^ t = V + W) ↔
      (V = ∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), σ t * ν t * (2 ^ b) ^ t ∧
        W = ∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), σ t * (1 - ν t) * (2 ^ b) ^ t) := by
